# Modularity

Removed from Abora OS in 4.2. Modularity (a game engine editor by Tareno Labs) is no longer bundled or
specially packaged; it installs like any other program. See `docs/wiki/Packages.md`.

This directory stays as a placeholder because the updater already installed on Abora 4.0 and 4.1 refuses to
update to a release that doesn't contain it. It will be deleted in a later release, once nobody updates from
those versions. See `scripts/release/legacy-required-paths.txt`.
